plan: E61 V3-DTF final-plan.md §10 tier 2 -- EXPLORATORY: no CONFIRMED/REFUTED arm by design

registered.image_trend_set: the primary arm's frames (the scalar arms refit on their own frames)
registered.patch_source: halves of the warm card region
registered.patch_geometry_is_label_blind: the card region, the cut axis and both patches come from the MEAN frame over every pass and both sides, which carries no W/E information, so the geometry cannot bias the contrast
registered.p_formula: (1 + #{|T_perm| >= |T_obs|}) / (1 + B), two-sided; conservative by one count for the enumerated nulls, whose B labellings include the observed
registered.units: mK (frames are degC; every statistic is x1000)
registered.sign_note: which image half is the die's West is a convention: read the magnitude, the permutation p and the lobe displacement, not the sign

hi.note: the extrema of the along-axis profile of the mean W-E image, over the card region

lo.note: the extrema of the along-axis profile of the mean W-E image, over the card region

hi.note: a separation reads the pattern's WIDTH, not its displacement

lo.note: a separation reads the pattern's WIDTH, not its displacement

spatial.identifiability: W - E alone gives the product (displacement x moved heat mass) in its first moment, not a displacement: separating them needs the pattern's own mass, and the hi-vs-lo level difference that could supply it is confounded with the pass's time trend (hi runs early, lo late, by design). So no millimetre displacement is reported. What IS identified, and drift- and fixed-pattern-immune, is the MONOPOLE (the card-mean difference, which a constant-work side swap should leave at zero) and the GRADIENT the swap imposes across the card, with its direction -- testable against the MESH-derived W/E axis -- plus the along-axis profile's extrema, which a reader can hold against the ~11 mm prediction and the card's own geometry.
spatial.expectation: plan §10: the pattern must MOVE between W and E (a sign-flipping gradient along the cut axis); if it does not, the camera is watching the voltage regulators -- the thermal hub's own prescribed control

warnings: the automatic card region covers 86% of the frame (42083 px): this scene may have no clean warm/ambient split, so the two 'halves of the card' may not be the die's halves. Look at cam_diff.png and pass --rect-w/--rect-e. Reading the mean frame to set them is legitimate (it is label-blind); reading a p-value first is not.
